description: List selected wallpaper materials with surface, width and primary use cases.

id.description: Optional. Return only the material with this id.

offset.description: Optional. Number of materials to skip, default 0.

priority.description: Optional. Filter by priority tag, e.g. brandschutz, robust, effekt, nachhaltig, feuchtraum.

name: list_materials

width_cm.description: Panel width in cm (maximum print width for Welltouch XL)

total.description: Number of matching materials before paging
